#!/usr/bin/env ruby

require 'optparse'

verbose = false
parser = OptionParser.new do |opts|
  opts.banner = 'Usage: wordcount.rb [--verbose] FILENAME'
  opts.on('--verbose', 'Also print the number of lines') { verbose = true }
end

begin
  parser.parse!
  raise OptionParser::MissingArgument, 'filename' unless ARGV.length == 1

  words = 0
  lines = 0
  File.foreach(ARGV.first) do |line|
    lines += 1
    words += line.split.length
  end

  puts "Words: #{words}"
  puts "Lines: #{lines}" if verbose
rescue OptionParser::ParseError, SystemCallError => e
  warn e.message
  warn parser if e.is_a?(OptionParser::ParseError)
  exit 1
end
